newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Essex sets semi-annual dividend.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Essex sets semi-annual dividend.

text.p: The Bank of Essex said Thursday it declared a semi-annual dividend of $0.18 per share to shareholders of record on December 12, 1996, payable December 31, 1996.

The company said in a release that combined with the $0.14 per share paid at mid-year, the $0.32 per share total for the year represents a 10 percent increase over the 1995 total dividend of $0.29 per share.
Bank of Essex, with total assets of $114,148,000 at November 30, 1996, operates offices in Tappahannock, Central Garage, Mechanicsville, and West Point, Virginia.
